insights: **Weekly Highlights —** Total sales jumped to $1,147 (+202.0% WoW) from $379 on 21 units, with Saturday, Nov 21 the peak day at $629 as momentum built through the back half of the week. PPC revenue grew to $787 (+73.1%), and the Plain Red Crazy Party Hat (B0HNMC1VNZ) led the catalog at $179 with a 15.8% conversion rate. The Royal Oversized Blank Hat rose to $104 (+40.0%) on 2 units (+100.0%) as its CVR improved to 11.8% (+52.9%).

**Metrics to Watch —** Sales were concentrated late in the week: Sun Nov 15 through Tue Nov 17 recorded $0 before daily sales built to $149, $52, $314 and $629, so the brand exits the week at a run-rate well above its weekly average. ROAS eased slightly to 2.10x (prior 2.16x) as ad spend was deliberately scaled to $375 (prior $210), an investment that brought in $787 in PPC revenue, while organic sales contributed $359. We are focused on carrying Saturday's momentum into the start of the coming week so every day contributes.

**Ad Spend Efficiency —** TACoS improved sharply to 32.7% from 55.39%, so advertising now takes a much smaller share of total sales. ROAS came in at 2.10x with ACOS at 47.6%, a 1.02% ad CTR and a 4.20% ad conversion rate. Budget is being directed toward the best-converting hats to push ACOS below 47.6% as spend continues to build volume.

**Actions This Week —** Increase bids and budget on the Plain Red Crazy Party Hat (15.8% CVR) and the Plain Navy Crazy Party Hat (20.0% CVR), the two highest-revenue SKUs at $179 and $157. Trim low-converting search terms to lift ad conversion above 4.20% and bring ACOS below 47.6%. Strengthen early-week bids on the top hats so Sunday through Tuesday, which recorded $0, start contributing sales.
